ValidationRule.description: Per Contracts (Courtney Louiselle) and Finance (Karen), Sep 2026, change request 00105850: the flat per-dispute chargeback fee the client pays must be settled before the contract is completed and must appear in the order form. Stops a New Business or Cross-Sell deal that carries a Payments-family product from entering Contract (or Closed Won) while Dispute Chargeback Fee is blank. 0 means the client pays no fee. Product Family RU is the Rollup Helper text of the product families on the deal (matches the Payments line items exactly).
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( RecordType.DeveloperName = "Standard_Opportunity", ISCHANGED(StageName), CASE( TEXT(StageName), "Lead Qualification", 1, "Discovery", 2, "SE Technical Review", 3, "Proposal", 4, "RFP", 5, "Award", 6, "Scoping", 7, "Contract", 8, "Closed Won", 9, 0 ) >= 8, CONTAINS(Product_Family_RU__c, "Payments"), ISBLANK(Charge_Back_Fee__c) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: This deal includes Payments: enter the Dispute Chargeback Fee (flat amount per dispute the client pays; 0 if none) before moving to Contract. It must match the order form.
